name: Harmony 600, the test setup with five devices
description: todo-compile-600 2.2, one write of lab/work/h600-from-nothing/setup5-600-blended.bin: the Harmony 650's test setup cut to the 600's five devices, without the Sony HT, and with it Muziek, and without the Switch, so five devices and four activities, built on the 600's empty configuration by our own generators and composers with no Logitech file as input, every screen in grey 2 with smoothed letters, section 388. By the file it does on the 600 what the same setup does on the 650 and the 700's six device setup did, the Switch aside, which no step below uses. Watch TV starts TV kijken, Watch a Movie starts Film kijken, and Listen to Music holds no activity, so it shows the 'add an Activity' screen. The activity menu has two pages: TV kijken and Film kijken, then Kodi kijken and Plasma kijken. Predicted: TV kijken sends the LG's, the KPN box's and the Denon's power, then the LG's HDMI 1 and the Denon's CBL/SAT; its volume goes to the Denon and its channels to the KPN box, also after a visit to the Denon's device pages. Film kijken from there sends the Plasma's power on (seven frames), Kodi's power and the LG's power, then the Plasma's HDMI 2 and the Denon's Media Player, and nothing to the KPN box, which is kept on between activities. Plasma kijken from there sends Kodi's and the Denon's power and the Plasma's HDMI 1, and nothing to the KPN box. Radio sends KPN 1 and about 2 s later KPN 2. All Off sends the Plasma's power off and the KPN box's power. The screen goes dark about 20 s after the last key. 'Turning system off' did not show on this 600 with the empty configuration, section 387, so it may not show here either. The remote holds one saved inter device delay, which this file's wiring does not restore, so the timings are the file's. The three buttons below the screen are the left arrow, the centre button and the right arrow. Please write in each step's note what you saw, also when it is what the step expects.

steps.instruction: Straight after the write the remote restarts. Take it off the cable and point it at the Flirc. Expect the Activities screen in grey, 'Activities 1/2' at the top, TV kijken on the upper row and Film kijken on the lower row, 'Devices' at the bottom; 'Turning system off' may show briefly first. Say if it shows anything else. Mark when it is quiet

Press Watch TV. Expect 'Starting TV kijken', the LG's, the KPN box's and the Denon's power, then the LG's HDMI 1 and the Denon's CBL/SAT, then a grey screen titled TV kijken with Teletext upper left and DVR upper right, 'Devices' at the bottom. Mark when it settles
Press Volume up once, then Channel up once. Expect the Denon's volume up, then the KPN box's channel up. Mark

Press the centre button below the screen ('Devices'). Expect 'Devices 1/2': LG TV upper left, KPN upper right, Denon lower left, Plasma lower right, 'Activity' at the bottom. Press the button beside Denon (lower left). Expect the Denon's pages, 'Denon 1/23'. Press Volume up once: expect the Denon's volume up. Mark

Press the centre button ('Back') until the TV kijken screen is back: once to the device list, then once more ('Activity'). Then press Channel up once. Expect the KPN box's channel up, as before the visit. Mark

Press Listen to Music. Expect a dark screen reading 'Use the Harmony setup software to add an Activity on this button.' with 'Exit' at the bottom, and nothing heard. Press the centre button ('Exit') and say where it goes. Mark

Press Watch a Movie. Expect 'Starting Film kijken', the Plasma's power on (seven frames), Kodi's power and the LG's power, then the Plasma's HDMI 2 and the Denon's Media Player, and nothing for the KPN box. Then a grey screen titled Film kijken with Aspect upper left, 3D upper right and Sleep lower left. Mark when it settles

Press More Activities. Expect 'Activities 1/2'. Press the right arrow below the screen once. Expect 'Activities 2/2' with Kodi kijken on the upper row and Plasma kijken on the lower row. Press the button beside Plasma kijken. Expect 'Starting Plasma kijken', Kodi's and the Denon's power, the Plasma's HDMI 1, and nothing for the KPN box. Then a grey screen with Teletext, DVR, Aspect and Radio in its corners. Mark when it settles
Press the button beside Radio (lower right) once and touch nothing. Expect the KPN box's 1 and about 2 s later its 2. Mark when the 2 has been heard, or when 10 s have passed without it
Press All Off. Expect the Plasma's power off and the KPN box's power, then the Activities screen. Say whether 'Turning system off' showed, even for a moment. Mark when it is quiet
Touch nothing and watch the screen: note roughly how many seconds after the last press it goes dark, about 20 expected. Then press any key once to wake it, and mark
